show saturday
scene makidayafter1
: Hey, sorry I’m late. I didn’t wind up falling asleep until a few hours ago and may or may not have slept through my alarm.
lines.zh: : 嘿,抱歉我迟到了。我几个小时前才睡着,而且可能——也可能没有——睡过了闹钟。

lines.en: : There’s no need to apologize. I’ve only been here for a little while myself.
lines.zh: : 不用道歉。我自己也才刚到一会儿。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Did {i}your{/i} husband die too?
lines.zh: : 是吗?{i}你{/i}丈夫也死了吗?

lines.en: scene makidayafter2
: Uhh...sorry.
lines.zh: : 呃……抱歉。

lines.en: : Fair warning, though- I’m one of those “mask the pain with jokes” types. So chances are that it’s going to happen again.
lines.zh: : 不过先说好——我是那种「用玩笑掩饰痛苦」的人。所以这种事大概率还会再发生。

lines.en: : If it happens, it happens. I don’t really have any right to talk about how uncomfortable {i}I{/i} am when you’re the one who has to deal with this.
lines.zh: : 发生就发生吧。要承受这些的人是你,{i}我{/i}实在没什么资格说自己有多不自在。

lines.en: scene makidayafter3
: Well, I appreciate that as you’re the first person I’ve been able to actually talk {i}to{/i} about this. The fact that you respect my newfound status as a widow really means a lot.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我很感激,因为你是第一个我能真正聊聊这事的人。你能尊重我这个新晋寡妇的身份,对我真的很重要。

lines.en: : Was that another joke?
lines.zh: : 这又是个玩笑吧?

lines.en: : It was supposed to be. It sounded funnier in my head.
lines.zh: : 本来是想当玩笑说的。在我脑子里的时候更好笑。

lines.en: : What about Sara and Haruka? You haven’t talked to them?
lines.zh: : 那 Sara 和 Haruka 呢?你还没跟她们说过?

lines.en: : I texted Sara yesterday. I’m going over to her place after this so I can tell her the full story.
lines.zh: : 我昨天给 Sara 发了消息。等这边结束我就去她家,把事情完整告诉她。

lines.en: : Haruka, I didn’t talk to until this morning...but she called me yesterday while I was handling Makoto.
lines.zh: : Haruka 我是今天早上才说的……不过她昨天给我打过电话,就在我安抚 Makoto 的时候。

lines.en: : When I looked at my recent calls, my heart dropped as I figured she’d just gone through the same thing I did...and that she was reaching out for someone to lean on.
lines.zh: : 我看到最近通话时,心一下子沉了下去,因为我以为她刚经历了和我一样的事……以为她想找个人依靠。

lines.en: scene makidayafter4
: Of course, that was before the text about how {i}her{/i} husband is still alive and how hearing the news was the best thing that ever happened to her.
lines.zh: : 当然,那是在收到那条短信之前——说{i}她{/i}丈夫还活着,说听到这个消息是她这辈子最开心的事。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
Well, it’s good to see that Haruka has an easier time lying through text than in person.
lines.zh: 好吧,看来 Haruka 用文字撒谎比当面撒谎要轻松得多。

lines.en: : Sooo...yeah. I kinda gave up on the idea of calling her yesterday out of a mix of envy and misdirected frustration.
lines.zh: : 所以……对。昨天我基本放弃了给她回电话的念头,一半是嫉妒,一半是没处撒的火气。

lines.en: : Especially considering the fact that she didn’t even {i}ask{/i} if I heard anything about my husband. But hey, she rarely ever finds the time to think about anyone other than herself anyway, so it is what it is.
lines.zh: : 尤其是她连一句「你丈夫有消息了吗」都没{i}问{/i}。不过话说回来,她本来就很少花时间替别人着想,所以也就这样了。

lines.en: : Actually, come to think of it, maybe my frustration {i}wasn’t{/i} misdirected...and that it was totally okay for me to be angry about that?
lines.zh: : 其实仔细想想,也许我的火气{i}并没有{/i}撒错地方……我为此生气也完全合情合理?

lines.en: scene makidayafter1
: Either way, it’s fine now. I told her on my way over this morning since I figured it would be easier than letting her see me as a zombie and figuring things out through context.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样,现在没事了。我今天早上过来的路上告诉她了,因为我觉得这总比让她看着我这副活死人的样子、再自己从上下文里猜出真相要好。

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, I think you look pretty good as a zombie.
lines.zh: : 如果这算安慰的话,我觉得你当活死人的样子还挺好看的。

lines.en: : It’s the hair. It keeps growing even after death.
lines.zh: : 是头发。死了以后它还在长。

lines.en: scene makidayafter5
: But, that aside, I guess you’re probably curious about what exactly {i}happened,{/i} right?
lines.zh: : 不过撇开这个不谈,我猜你大概很好奇到底{i}发生{/i}了什么,对吧?

lines.en: : I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t. But it’s not like I expect you to give me all of the specifics since going over them likely won’t do your mental health any good.
lines.zh: : 我说不好奇那就是撒谎。但我也不指望你把每个细节都讲一遍,毕竟重提这些对你的精神状态大概没什么好处。

lines.en: : You know, that’s the weirdest part.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,最奇怪的就是这个。

lines.en: : Like, yeah. Yesterday was one of the most miserable days of my life.
lines.zh: : 比如说,对。昨天是我这辈子最痛苦的一天之一。

lines.en: : But when I woke up this morning, I brushed my teeth...I got dressed...fixed my hair in the mirror...and for a moment, I forgot my husband was even dead.
lines.zh: : 可我今天早上醒来,刷了牙……穿好衣服……对着镜子整理了头发……有那么一瞬间,我忘了我丈夫已经死了。

lines.en: : When you rip away the constant realization of something you love being gone, it’s easy to just trick yourself back into feeling normal.
lines.zh: : 当你把「某个你爱的人已经不在了」这个持续不断的意识剥掉之后,很容易就骗自己重新感觉一切正常。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe it just hasn’t fully set in yet.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。也许只是还没完全反应过来。

lines.en: : But being able to sit at this table without needing to use your sleeve to dry my tears is pretty nice.
lines.zh: : 不过能坐在这张桌子前,不需要用袖子擦眼泪,感觉还挺好的。

lines.en: : Uhh...good morning.
lines.zh: : 呃……早上好。

lines.en: scene makidayafter6
: Good morning, Rin. I like your hair like that.
lines.zh: : 早上好,Rin。我喜欢你今天的发型。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...thanks. But that’s...not really why I...
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……谢谢。不过那……其实不是我来的原因……

lines.en: scene makidayafter7
: Is everything okay? Like...with Makoto?
lines.zh: : 一切都还好吗?比如……Makoto 那边?

lines.en: : I heard that she got called to the office yesterday and never came back. And then Miku left too and...
lines.zh: : 我听说她昨天被叫去办公室就再也没回来。然后 Miku 也走了,而且……

lines.en: : And now you guys are here and the vibe is all weird and neither of you have even ordered anything and-
lines.zh: : 现在你们俩又在这儿,气氛怪怪的,而且你们连东西都没点,而且——

lines.en: : You don’t have to worry. Everything’s fine.
lines.zh: : 你不用担心。一切都好。

lines.en: : Makoto’s just probably not going to be back in school for a while.
lines.zh: : Makoto 大概只是有一段时间不会回学校了。

lines.en: : Is she, like...in trouble? Because we don’t really talk much, but she’s seriously one of the most well-behaved people I’ve ever met. And like, there’s no way she actually did something bad.
lines.zh: : 她是……惹上麻烦了吗?因为我们其实不怎么说话,但她真的是我见过最守规矩的人之一。而且,她绝对不可能做了什么坏事。

lines.en: : She’s not in trouble, don’t worry. It’s just not something you need to be concerned about right now.
lines.zh: : 她没有惹上麻烦,别担心。只是这件事现在还不需要你操心。

lines.en: : If Makoto wants you to know, she’ll tell you. But knowing that girl, she probably just wants to keep things to herself for now.
lines.zh: : 如果 Makoto 想让你知道,她会告诉你的。不过按照我对那孩子的了解,她现在大概只想把这些事藏在心里。

lines.en: scene makidayafter8
: Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : Can I at least get you something to drink? Coffee? Tea?
lines.zh: : 那我至少给你拿点喝的吧?咖啡?茶?

lines.en: : Coffee sounds nice, actually. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 咖啡听起来不错。谢谢。

lines.en: : And I’ll just have whatever you decide to make me today.
lines.zh: : 至于我,你今天想做什么给我都行。

lines.en: scene makidayafter9
: Got it...
lines.zh: : 明白了……

lines.en: : I’ll...uhhh...
: Yeah.
scene makidayafter10
Rin wanders back behind the bar and begins to get our drinks ready, prompting Maki to focus on her as a means of temporarily escaping the reality of the conversation we’re here to have.
lines.zh: Rin 晃回吧台后面,开始准备我们的饮料,而 Maki 则把注意力集中在她身上,借此暂时逃离我们此行要谈的那场现实。

lines.en: I don’t attempt to pull her away as even I don’t like having to do this.
lines.zh: 我没有试着把她拉回来,因为连我自己也不喜欢非做这件事不可。

lines.en: The whole way here this morning, I was dreading it.
lines.zh: 今天早上过来的这一路,我都在发怵。

lines.en: Not because I don’t want to see Maki sad...or not because I don’t want to be {i}aware{/i} that Makoto is sad either...
lines.zh: 不是因为我不想看到 Maki 难过……也不是因为我不{i}想知道{/i} Makoto 在难过……

lines.en: Those things are horrible, don’t get me wrong-
lines.zh: 这些事当然很可怕,别误会——

lines.en: But the reason I was dreading this is because I have no idea what {i}I{/i} am meant to do here.
lines.zh: 但{i}我{/i}发怵的真正原因是,我完全不知道我在这里该做什么。

lines.en: I can’t {i}console{/i} anyone. And Maki is far too old and not nearly naive enough to treat my words as gospel.
lines.zh: 我{i}安慰{/i}不了任何人。而 Maki 年纪太大,也远没有天真到会把我的话当成信条。

lines.en: She’s an adult dealing with an adult issue in an adult way and I’m...
lines.zh: 她是在以成年人的方式处理一个成年人的问题,而我……

lines.en: I’m admittedly not good with things like that.
lines.zh: 我得承认,我不擅长这种事。

lines.en: If only her daughter were here.
lines.zh: 要是她女儿在这儿就好了。

lines.en: If only there was someone still too inexperienced with the world to see through the lack of meaning in all that I say.
lines.zh: 要是还有一个人,对这个世界足够缺乏经验,看不穿我说的那些话有多空洞,就好了。

lines.en: And how despite acknowledging that, I still wholeheartedly believe it all.
lines.zh: 而我明明清楚这一点,却依然全心全意地相信着自己说的每一句。

lines.en: : I like her.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢她。

lines.en: : As...a barista? Or as a human being?
lines.zh: : 作为……咖啡师?还是作为一个人?

lines.en: : Mostly as a barista. She seems pretty high maintenance. But she seems like a good person too.
lines.zh: : 主要是作为咖啡师。她看起来挺难伺候的。不过人也像是好人。

lines.en: : You deal with Miku on a regular basis and you’re worried about how high maintenance {i}Rin{/i} is?
lines.zh: : 你天天跟 Miku 打交道,还担心 {i}Rin{/i} 难伺候?

lines.en: scene makidayafter11
: Okay, listen. Miku may be hyper, but she’s pretty one dimensional when you strip away the baggage she carries.
lines.zh: : 好吧,听着。Miku 是很闹腾,但把她背着的那些包袱剥掉之后,她其实相当单纯。

lines.en: : I always know what I’m going to get with her. Just...unreserved, innocent sweetness and childlike fascination with pretty much everything and everyone she sees on a regular basis.
lines.zh: : 跟她在一起,我永远知道会得到什么。就是……毫无保留的、天真烂漫的甜,还有对她日常所见的一切人和事都像孩子一样的好奇。

lines.en: : There’s a reason I call her my second daughter, you know.
lines.zh: : 我叫她第二个女儿是有原因的,你知道的。

lines.en: : Is it because your first one doesn’t like you enough?
lines.zh: : 是因为你第一个女儿不够喜欢你吗?

lines.en: scene makidayafter12
: Woah, there! Only I’m allowed to make jokes like that today! When you do it, it just makes everything feel more real.
lines.zh: : 喂喂,打住!今天只有我能开这种玩笑!换成你来说,只会让一切都显得更真实。

lines.en: : Sorry. I’m a lot better at dragging down the mood than lightening it.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我更擅长把气氛拖下去,而不是把它弄轻松。

lines.en: scene makidayafter13
: Then I guess I’ll have to switch roles and be the one to make things sad again.
lines.zh: : 那看来我得换个角色,重新来当那个把气氛弄沉重的人。

lines.en: : Or we can just...you know, avoid that.
lines.zh: : 或者我们可以就……你知道的,别聊这个。

lines.en: : If it were a small problem, sure. I’d be all for just ignoring it and waiting for it to get bigger.
lines.zh: : 如果是个小问题,当然。我很乐意就这么无视它,等它自己变大。

lines.en: : But what we’re dealing with is something that has dramatically altered both my life and my daughter’s life. And seeing as you play a part in both of those lives, you should be in the know.
lines.zh: : 可我们现在面对的这件事,已经彻底改变了我的人生和我女儿的人生。既然你在这两段人生里都占了一席之地,你就应该知道。

lines.en: : Maki-
lines.zh: : Maki——

lines.en: : Yesterday morning, I got a call from my husband’s branch in the JSDF or...KMDF? Whatever the name of the defense force is called. I really wasn’t paying much attention to that part.
lines.zh: : 昨天早上,我接到一个电话,是我丈夫所在的那支部队打来的,什么 JSDF 还是……KMDF?管它那支防卫队叫什么名字。那部分我真没怎么注意听。

lines.en: : In fact, I was barely paying attention {i}at all{/i} when the call started since it sounded like it was going to be one of those robots who try to sell you stuff. You know?
lines.zh: : 事实上,电话刚接通的时候我{i}基本{/i}没在听,因为听起来就像是那种给你推销东西的机器人。你懂吧?

lines.en: : But just as I was about to hang up, I heard my husband’s name and started to put the pieces together.
lines.zh: : 可就在我准备挂断的时候,我听到了我丈夫的名字,然后开始把一切拼起来。

lines.en: : Which is probably why I remember the rest of the call word-for-word when I’ve already forgotten the beginning.
lines.zh: : 大概正因为如此,我已经忘了开头,却能把剩下的内容一字不落地记下来。

lines.en: scene makidayafter14
: Masahiro Miyamura.
lines.zh: : Masahiro Miyamura。

lines.en: : Status: deceased.
lines.zh: : 状态:已死亡。

lines.en: : Cause of death: asphyxiation.
lines.zh: : 死因:窒息。

lines.en: : Date and time of death: June 19th, 21:13.
lines.zh: : 死亡日期与时间:6 月 19 日,21:13。

lines.en: : Remember to smile.
lines.zh: : 请记得微笑。

lines.en: : Transmission over.
lines.zh: : 播报结束。

lines.en: : June 19th? But that’s-
lines.zh: : 6 月 19 日?可那是——

lines.en: : They waited two months to tell me.
lines.zh: : 他们拖了两个月才告诉我。

lines.en: : For two fucking months, my husband has been dead.
lines.zh: : 整整两个月,我丈夫都已经死了。

lines.en: : And we’ve been talking about him and telling stories about what we’ll do when he gets back without a single fucking clue.
lines.zh: : 而我们还在聊着他,还在讲他回来以后我们要做什么——一个他妈的知情都没有。

lines.en: : Isn’t that ridiculous?
lines.zh: : 这不是很荒唐吗?

lines.en: scene makidayafter15
: They didn’t even have the dignity to make a {i}person{/i} call me.
lines.zh: : 他们甚至没有那份体面,让一个真{i}人{/i}来给我打电话。

lines.en: : To have a {i}real, live fucking person{/i} call and tell me my daughter will never see her father again.
lines.zh: : 让一个他妈的{i}活生生的真人{/i}打来,告诉我,我女儿再也见不到她父亲了。

lines.en: : This is a man who lived for over 30 years...who had a daughter...who went into fucking {i}space{/i} to fight in a war despite being a wimpy ass pacifist...and all he gets in memoriam is an {i}automated phone call?{/i}
lines.zh: : 这个人活了三十多年……有个女儿……明明是个怂得要命的和平主义者,却还是上了他妈的{i}太空{/i}去打仗……而他得到的全部纪念,就只是一通{i}自动电话{/i}?

lines.en: : Are you fucking kidding me?
lines.zh: : 你他妈在开玩笑吗?

lines.en: : That’s seriously it?
lines.zh: : 就真的只有这些?

lines.en: scene makidayafter16
: No...No, it’s fine. That’s not even the big issue right now. After all, he’s been dead for {i}two fucking months.{/i} The big issue {i}now{/i} is getting Makoto over this hurdle.
lines.zh: : 不……不,没事。这甚至都不是眼下最大的问题。毕竟,他已经死了{i}整整两个月{/i}了。{i}现在{/i}最大的问题,是让 Makoto 迈过这道坎。

lines.en: : It’s spending the next fucking...I don’t know, two years. Three years. Any amount of fucking years watching her excitedly spout out plans for his return and then {i}remembering{/i} that he’s fucking gone.
lines.zh: : 是接下来那该死的……我不知道,两年。三年。随便是多少年,看着她兴冲冲地讲着他回来以后要做什么,然后再一次{i}想起来{/i}他已经他妈的不在了。

lines.en: : Do you think {i}she{/i} got up this morning, brushed her teeth, and fixed her hair in the mirror? Fuck no.
lines.zh: : 你觉得{i}她{/i}今天早上会爬起来、刷牙、对着镜子整理头发吗?他妈的才不会。

lines.en: scene makidayafter17
: That’s my little girl, Sensei. That’s my little girl and she’s suffering. She’s suffering and I can’t even do anything about it because, let’s face it, {i}who the fuck could in my shoes?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那是我的小女儿啊,Sensei。那是我的小女儿,而她正在受苦。她在受苦,而我却什么都做不了,因为说真的,{i}换作谁处在我的位置上{/i}又能怎样?

lines.en: : How about you, though?
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来,你呢?

lines.en: : What do you mean? What about me?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思?我怎么了?

lines.en: : I mean how are {i}you{/i} going to get over this hurdle?
lines.zh: : 我是说,{i}你{/i}要怎么迈过这道坎?

lines.en: scene makidayafter18
: Makoto’s not the only person who lost something. You did too. And you need to grieve just as badly as she does.
lines.zh: : Makoto 不是唯一失去东西的人。你也失去了。而你和她一样,同样需要哀悼。

lines.en: : What? Am I wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么?我说错了吗?

lines.en: scene makidayafter19
: Hah...
: It’s going to be hard explaining this to someone without a kid.
lines.zh: : 要跟一个没有孩子的人解释这件事,挺难的。

lines.en: : I have Ami. She’s close enough.
lines.zh: : 我有 Ami。差不多也够了。

lines.en: : If she was “close enough” you’d understand that what you just said might {i}sound{/i} good...but that’s really it. Just sound.
lines.zh: : 如果她真的「差不多够了」,你就会明白,你刚才那句话也许{i}听着{/i}很好听……但也仅此而已。只是好听。

lines.en: : I want to grieve. I want to struggle. It feels wrong {i}not{/i} doing that right now.
lines.zh: : 我想哀悼。我想挣扎。现在{i}不这么做{/i},反而觉得不对劲。

lines.en: scene makidayafter20
: But, as of yesterday, I'm the only parent Makoto has left.
lines.zh: : 可是从昨天起,我就是 Makoto 仅剩的家长了。

lines.en: : And if {i}I{/i} start breaking down and forgetting to eat and shower and brush my teeth, there’s no way that she’ll get over this in a healthy way.
lines.zh: : 而如果{i}我{/i}开始崩溃、开始忘记吃饭、洗澡、刷牙,她就不可能健康地熬过这件事。

lines.en: : So {i}that{/i} is what I’m worried about right now. Getting {i}her{/i} over this.
lines.zh: : {i}所以{/i}这才是我现在担心的事。让{i}她{/i}熬过去。

lines.en: : I can cry when that’s done.
lines.zh: : 等那件事办完了,我再哭。

lines.en: scene makidayafter21
As if on cue, Haruka walks into the cafe and immediately takes note of the friend she absentmindedly forgot to check on yesterday.
lines.zh: 像是掐准了时间,Haruka 走进了咖啡馆,立刻注意到了那位她昨天心不在焉忘了去关心的朋友。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
And while Haruka and I certainly have our own share of “issues” that we’ll need to address, that doesn’t matter right now.
lines.zh: 虽然我和 Haruka 之间确实也有一堆需要解决的「问题」,但眼下那都不重要。

lines.en: scene makidayafter22
She stops at the counter and grabs a small tray of drinks and assorted pastries that Rin prepared for us but likely refrained from delivering on account of the conversation heating up.
lines.zh: 她在吧台前停下,端起一小托盘饮料和各色点心——那是 Rin 给我们准备的,但大概是看到谈话气氛越来越紧张,就没好意思送过来。

lines.en: With Maki’s eyes still closed in either reflection or avoidance at the sound of the door opening, I find no other space to rest {i}my{/i} eyes than in Haruka’s.
lines.zh: 听到开门声,Maki 依然闭着眼睛,不知是在沉思还是在回避,而{i}我{/i}发现自己的目光无处可放,只能落在 Haruka 眼睛上。

lines.en: In that moment, hers rest in mine as well.
lines.zh: 而在那一刻,她的目光也落在了我的眼睛上。

lines.en: And they become congruent not in the fact that they share the same level of concern for someone that we enjoy the company of-
lines.zh: 这两道目光之所以重合,并不是因为我们同样担心某个我们喜欢与之相处的人——

lines.en: But in the fact that they share in mutual pity.
lines.zh: 而是因为我们同样怀着对彼此的怜悯。

lines.en: For we may {i}think{/i} that we can connect with Maki in this moment.
lines.zh: 因为我们也许{i}以为{/i},此刻的自己能与 Maki 心意相通。

lines.en: But truly no one can without having experienced what she has.
lines.zh: 但如果没有经历过她所经历的,就没有人真的能。

lines.en: scene makidayafter23
Haruka puts the tray down and fills her arms with something else before saying what any reasonable person in this situation would.
lines.zh: Haruka 放下托盘,把怀里换成了别的东西,然后说出了任何一个正常人在这种场合都会说的话。

lines.en: : I’m so sorry for your loss...
lines.zh: : 我对你的损失深感抱歉……

lines.en: But what does saying something like that even do?
lines.zh: 可说这种话到底有什么用?

lines.en: What good is the apology of an uninvolved party in the face of having your life ripped away from you?
lines.zh: 在一个人的人生被硬生生撕走的时候,一个局外人的道歉能顶什么用?

lines.en: Are we not meant to mask our pity in situations like these?
lines.zh: 在这种场合,我们不就是该把怜悯掩饰起来吗?

lines.en: Are we not meant to scrounge up more genuine responses than we’d be able to find at the bottom of a barrel?
lines.zh: 我们不就是该翻箱倒柜,找出比桶底那点货色更真诚的回应吗?

lines.en: Are we truly supposed to say we’re {i}sorry?{/i}
lines.zh: 我们真的应该说「我很{i}抱歉{/i}」吗?

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么?

lines.en: It doesn’t make sense.
lines.zh: 这说不通。

lines.en: But I suppose most things in this life don’t.
lines.zh: 不过我想,这世上大多数事情都说不通。

lines.en: And I suppose that sometimes a genuinely sorrowful canned response can work as serviceable acknowledgment of that.
lines.zh: 而且我想,有时候一句真心实意的套话,倒也能勉强算是对这种说不通的承认。

lines.en: : Thanks, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 谢谢,Haruka。

lines.en: : I’m really happy for you.
lines.zh: : 我真心为你高兴。

lines.en: : Maki...if I knew that your husband-
lines.zh: : Maki……如果我知道你丈夫——

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. You were excited and...wanted to share the news with someone.
lines.zh: : 别放在心上。你当时很兴奋,而且……想跟人分享这个消息。

lines.en: : You had no way of knowing.
lines.zh: : 你不可能知道的。

lines.en: : But if I did, I-
lines.zh: : 可如果我知道了,我——

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: : 没关系。

lines.en: : So...thanks for your apology. I really appreciate it. But if you don’t mind, I’d like to finish up my conversation with Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那么……谢谢你的道歉。我真的很感激。不过如果你不介意,我想先把和 Sensei 的这段话说完。

lines.en: : You and I can talk later.
lines.zh: : 我们晚点再聊。

lines.en: scene black
Maki tells me more about what she expects from Makoto going forward.
lines.zh: Maki 又跟我讲了讲她对 Makoto 接下来的打算。

lines.en: She has no idea when she’ll be able to return to school, but assured me that it wouldn’t be a problem as Miku would be taking all of her work directly to her.
lines.zh: 她不知道 Makoto 什么时候能回学校,但向我保证这不成问题,因为 Miku 会把她所有的作业直接送到她手上。

lines.en: As if that would even matter right now.
lines.zh: 好像现在这事儿还有什么要紧似的。

lines.en: I’m not just saying this because I am a horrible teacher, but the last thing I expect out of a girl whose father just died is {i}schoolwork.{/i}
lines.zh: 我这么说不全是因为我是个糟糕的老师,而是对一个父亲刚死的女孩,我最不指望的就是「{i}作业{/i}」。

lines.en: Regardless, I nod and tell Maki not to worry about it- going so far as even offering to deliver Makoto’s “schoolwork” myself.
lines.zh: 尽管如此,我还是点点头,叫 Maki 别担心——我甚至主动提出,由我亲自去送 Makoto 的「作业」。

lines.en: But of course, she in her unwavering devotion to not burdening anyone, refuses such a gesture before getting up from the table and straightening out her clothes.
lines.zh: 可她当然一如既往地坚持不肯麻烦任何人,拒绝了这番好意,然后从桌边站起来,把衣服拉平整。

lines.en: scene makidayafter24
: Thanks again for meeting with me. I didn’t want the Maki from yesterday ruining your thoughts about the Maki from the future.
lines.zh: : 再次谢谢你来见我。我可不想让昨天那个 Maki 毁掉你对未来那个 Maki 的印象。

lines.en: : I like all Makis equally. Though, I could do with this one being a little more selfish when it comes to her personal feelings.
lines.zh: : 所有版本的 Maki 我一样都喜欢。不过,要是这一个在个人感受上能自私一点,我会更欣慰。

lines.en: : Psht. Who needs feelings anyway? All they ever do is get in the way.
lines.zh: : 切。谁需要感情啊?感情除了碍事什么也不干。

lines.en: : I’ve got a genius to take care of, Sensei. If she stays upset, she’ll never develop the cure for whatever the next big pandemic is.
lines.zh: : 我有个天才要照顾呢,Sensei。她要是一直这么消沉,就永远研发不出下一种大流行病的解药了。

lines.en: : I am doing this to save the world. My tears mean nothing in the face of the greater good.
lines.zh: : 我这么做是为了拯救世界。在更大的善面前,我的眼泪一文不值。

lines.en: : Well, whatever the case, good luck. And if you need any help with Makoto, don’t hesitate to ask.
lines.zh: : 好吧,不管怎样,祝你好运。如果 Makoto 那边需要帮忙,尽管开口。

lines.en: scene makidayafter25
: Leave it to me, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 交给我吧,Sensei!

lines.en: : There’s no problem that Maki Miyamura can’t handle!
lines.zh: : 没有 Maki Miyamura 解决不了的问题!

lines.en: scene black
Maki says goodbye and wanders off to meet up with Sara and give her what I imagine will be a very similar speech.
lines.zh: Maki 道了别,转身去找 Sara,而我猜她会对 Sara 说一番差不多的话。

lines.en: I watch from the opposite side of the window, expecting to see her break down now that she’s no longer faced with a situation where she feels obligated to keep her tears in.
lines.zh: 我从窗户的另一侧望着她,以为会看到她崩溃——毕竟现在她不再需要强忍着眼泪了。

lines.en: But she’s an adult.
lines.zh: 可她是个成年人。

lines.en: So she probably holds it in until she’s at least a few blocks away.
lines.zh: 所以她大概会一直忍着,至少走到几个街区之外。
